dump-exif
tasks.command: mkdir -p .tmp && magick identify -verbose images/fulls/*.JPG 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'DateTimeOriginal|Model:|FocalLength:|Aperture:|Exposure:|ISO:' | head -n 200 > .tmp/exif_dump.txt && printf 'done\n'
